items.headline: Alabama's Mississippi State jab tops trolls from Week 5 college football
items.description: Alabama took to social media to needle its Starkville hosts, writing "Not enough cowbells" in reference to Davis Wade Stadium's famous noise-making tradition.

items.headline: Kam Davis propels Liberty to 30-14 victory over Delaware in Conference USA opener
items.description: — Kam Davis rushed for 147 yards and two touchdowns to lead Liberty to a 30-14 victory over Delaware on Friday night in a Conference USA opener for both teams.

items.headline: Game Day Kickoff: An epic QB showcase in Starkville and the best of the rest of Week 5
items.description: Kamario Taylor and Mississippi State will face their biggest test yet. Plus: teams on upset watch and other games to watch.

items.headline: Connelly: What changed in college football during September
items.description: It's dangerous to lean on lessons learned in one month, but here's what we think we know so far.

items.headline: Liberty and Delaware meet in CUSA play
items.description: Liberty (3-1) at Delaware (2-2), Oct. 2 at 7 p.m. EDT.

items.headline: Texas' UT jab at Tennessee leads top trolls of college football Week 4
items.description: Texas left Knoxville with a parting shot at its hosts centered on the two schools' shared UT acronym.
